---
description: "Use when working on SPF routing algorithms, controllers, or tests under SPF/. Keep changes minimal, preserve existing behavior, and run the relevant SPF tests after edits."
applyTo: "SPF/**"
---
# SPF Project Guidelines

- Prefer minimal, localized changes.
- Preserve existing algorithm names, public APIs, and file layout unless the task explicitly asks for a refactor.
- Keep SPF controllers and helper algorithms consistent with surrounding patterns.
- Update or add tests under SPF/tests when behavior changes.
- Run the relevant SPF tests after any behavior change.
